tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary actions, links and active elements. As text: 8.8:1 on `background`, 7.8:1 on `surface`. As a fill, label it with `on-primary`, never white (white on primary is 1.9:1). Also the keyboard focus ring.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of anything painted in `primary` — never a second primary colour.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Labels and icons on `primary` / `primary-hover` fills (8.8:1 / 9.9:1). Added alongside the spec: the spec gives no text colour for primary fills.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: The main app canvas.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, modals and input backgrounds, on top of `background`.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings and primary body text on `background` (17:1) and `surface` (15.1:1).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints and descriptions on `background` (11.3:1) and `surface` (10:1).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers, outlines and input borders. Contrast flag: 2.6:1 on `background`, 2.3:1 on `surface` — below the 3:1 the spec asks of control boundaries, so fine for decorative dividers; an input relying on this outline alone to be found does not meet it.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Successful outcomes. Always paired with an icon or word. As text: 11.1:1 on `background`, 9.9:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution. Always paired with an icon or word. As text: 12.9:1 on `background`, 11.4:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions. Always paired with an icon or word. As text: 6.7:1 on `background`, 5.9:1 on `surface`; as a fill, label it with `on-primary` (6.7:1).

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page titles and hero headings. One per page; around 32px on small screens.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pick a challenge, set a timer and ship a solution before it runs out.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Secondary labels and timestamps. The smallest size for essential information.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon gaps and micro adjustments.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Compact element spacing.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input padding and small card gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Standard padding and content gaps — the default gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding and section spacing.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Large component gaps.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Major section separation and page layout.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Square corners for full-bleed images and tables that run edge to edge.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Small controls and badges.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Inputs and buttons.

tokens.name: radius-3
tokens.usage: Cards and dropdowns.

tokens.name: radius-4
tokens.usage: Large cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-5
tokens.usage: Feature panels and hero containers. Use selectively.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Fully rounded pills and circles — avatars, toggles, pill tags. Use selectively.

tokens.name: border-width
tokens.usage: Every component outline and divider: buttons, inputs, cards, badges.

tokens.name: focus-ring-width
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline on every interactive element, drawn in `primary` with a 2px offset.
